verses.text: At Mizpah, Israel’s men had sworn this oath: ‘None of us will give a daughter to a man from Benjamin as a wife.’ 📜
The people went to Bethel and sat before God until evening, crying bitterly. 😢
They said, ‘Yahweh, God of Israel, how did this happen? Why is one tribe missing from Israel today?’ 🙏
Early the next day, they got up, built an altar there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. 🔥
Israel’s people asked, ‘Which tribe didn’t come to the assembly before Yahweh at Mizpah?’ They had sworn a severe oath: anyone who didn’t come before Yahweh there must be put to death. ⚖️
Israel grieved for their brother Benjamin: ‘One tribe has been cut off from Israel today. 💔
‘How can we find wives for the survivors? We swore to Yahweh that we wouldn’t give them any of our daughters.’ 😔
Then they asked, ‘Which tribe didn’t come before Yahweh at Mizpah?’ No one from Jabesh-Gilead had come to the camp and assembly. 🗣️
When the people were counted, not one person from Jabesh-Gilead was there. 🔎
The assembly sent twelve thousand of its bravest men to Jabesh-Gilead with this order: ‘Attack the people with swords, including the women and children. ⚔️
‘This is what you must do: kill every male and every woman who has slept with a man.’ ⚠️
Among Jabesh-Gilead’s people they found four hundred young women who had never slept with a man. They brought them to the camp at Shiloh, in Canaan. 🚶
Then the whole assembly sent a message of peace to Benjamin’s survivors at Rimmon Rock. 🕊️
Benjamin returned, and the Israelites gave them the women they had kept alive from Jabesh-Gilead. But there still weren’t enough women for them. 😔
The people grieved for Benjamin, because Yahweh had left a gap among Israel’s tribes. 💔
The assembly’s elders asked, ‘How can we find wives for the survivors? Benjamin’s women have been wiped out.’ 😢
They said, ‘The survivors must have an inheritance, or one of Israel’s tribes will disappear. 🏠
‘But we can’t give them wives from our daughters. Israel swore, “Cursed is anyone who gives a wife to Benjamin.”’ 📜
Then they said, ‘There’s Yahweh’s yearly festival at Shiloh, north of Bethel, east of the road from Bethel to Shechem, and south of Lebonah.’ 🗺️
They instructed Benjamin’s men, ‘Go and hide in the vineyards. 🌿
‘Watch for Shiloh’s young women to come out dancing at the festival. Then rush out from the vineyards, and each of you seize a wife from among them. Take her back to Benjamin’s land.’ ⚠️

‘If their fathers or brothers come complain to us, we’ll tell them, “Please let them go; we couldn’t get a wife for each man through battle, and you didn’t give your daughters to them. So you haven’t broken your oath.”’ 🗣️
Benjamin’s men did this. They took wives by seizing the number they needed from among the women who danced. Then they returned to their land, rebuilt their towns, and settled there. ⚠️
At that time, Israel’s people left. Each person returned to their tribe and family, and to their own inheritance. 🧳
Back then, Israel had no king. Everyone did whatever seemed right to them. ⚖️
